lines: k0, dflash_k7, dspark_k7, dspark_var as v2.4 has them, each beside an arm with the prefix cache on (prefix_cache, k0_line k0_pc); the round-robin arms leave
panels: the shared-prefix panels S0, S512, S1024, S2048 and their warm-up panels; D48, K128 and K128b stay for identity and the panel builder; the long panels leave
warmup: a panel that names a warm-up panel warms up on that panel's first C prompts, which the measurement never sees
kv_budget: a panel's warm-up prompts count as its own
gates: G_prefix is new; equivalence and identity as v2.4
open_loop, samehost, diagnosis, round_robin, long_context and v2.4's pilot leave; prefix, main and pilot are new

gpu.name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

main.rule: a clean clone of one commit from a git bundle of the local branch, which stays off the public repository; every line's --commit

order: all lines of one (panel, C, seed) run back to back in one job; the i-th seed (0-based) of the dev seeds starts with the (i mod n)-th of main.lines' n lines and continues in listed order
kv_budget: C * ceil((max_prompt_len + max_tokens + 7) / 256) target blocks for every line, max_prompt_len over the measured panel and its warm-up panel; a block draft's cache mirrors the target's blocks

warmup.requests: first C of the panel, cycled; for a panel that names a warm-up panel, that panel's first C

timing_noise.runs_in: every main job on its own panel: at the seed and each concurrency the group's runs of these lines run a second time right after the group; the two must be token-identical; N_t is the largest |a/b - 1| of Q_steady over the job's 12 pairs, and that job's verdicts use it

decision.a_beats_b: all paired gains same sign and abs(median) > 2*N_t
decision.report: median (min-max), two decimals; range only if max-min > 0.05. The README's headline, total table and figures are the exception: only the median of the 3 seeds, marked as such; the ranges go in RESULTS
decision.revised: 2026-11-02: the README rule of report decided by the author; the verdicts are unchanged

invalid_if: a step other than a prefill > 3 x the median of its kind
lines of one (C, seed) split across jobs: one job is one directory, protocol and panel, each line at the commit of its tree

verify_schedule.made_by: job A on a G4 runtime at 5bf4cbc: tools/profile_verify_cost.py, then tools/fit_confidence_sts.py; seed 17011's calibration run was invalid (a round 5.15 x its median). The first rerun ran on kernels compiled under TORCH_LOGS=recompiles, which changes the kernels and the outputs, so it is not job A's command and does not count; a clean rerun passed with byte-identical confidences; reviewed by the author before this protocol is frozen

cost_curve.round: one round's phase timings summed, propose through commit_copy, on CUDA events; every row verifies query_len positions through the variable-length path, the confidence copy included; fresh requests of context_len random tokens for every (batch, query_len)
cost_curve.revised: 2026-11-02 from v2.1's external.cost_curve, which timed the verify forward alone: the schedule weighs a whole round

calibration.record: every round, each row's 7 confidence logits and its accepted count; all 8 positions are verified, so 'the first i drafts all accepted' is observed for every i
calibration.method: STS: for i = 1..7 in turn, T_i on the grid minimizing the binary cross-entropy of the survival prod_{j<=i} sigmoid(z_j / T_j) against 'the first i drafts all accepted', T_1..T_{i-1} fixed
report_only: ECE over 10 equal-width bins, per position and pooled, raw and after STS
AUROC of the survival pooled over positions, raw and after STS

replay.rounds: the calibration runs' rounds of C rows
replay.rule: a row with n of its 7 drafts accepted accepts min(n, L - 1) when it verifies L positions; a round's time is the cost table's at its token count, the fixed-length round's at 8 per row
replay.source: 2 x N_t, N_t = 1.26% in the cluster's job 236550, kept until the G4's own is measured

confirm.runs_in: nowhere: M6 runs no confirmation set; the identity job only reads this concurrency

equivalence.reference: repeat 1 of the cluster reproduction, job 236550

G_prefix.prompts: the first per_category prompts of each category of the panel, in panel order
G_prefix.donor: the first prompt of the panel's warm-up panel
G_prefix.reference: hashing off: each test prompt prefilled alone; the prefill's last-position logits, then the draft's first block forward over it (k rows), then k+1 target decode steps, each appending its own argmax
G_prefix.floor: hashing off: the test prompts prefilled 4 at a time, the same draft forward and k+1 decode steps 4 rows at a time, every row forced to its reference's first token and decode tokens
G_prefix.hit: hashing on: the donor prefilled and kept, then each test prompt prefilled alone, which must hit at least the panel's shared tokens; the same draft forward and decode steps, forced to the reference's tokens
G_prefix.rule: per line and panel: the target's largest |hit - reference| over every prompt and position at most floor_multiple x the target's largest |floor - reference|, the same for the draft's logits; and the argmax agrees, target and draft, wherever the reference's top-2 margin exceeds margin

identity.rule: the tree at the job's commit against the reference's tokens, request by request, and the environment against job C's manifest: outputs/colab/m4-preflight.sh, m4-preflight-check.py. dev.lines on D48 at confirm.concurrency, seed 17011, against job C's repeat 1; gates.equivalence's dspark_k7 on K128b under protocol v2.1, against the cluster reproduction's repeat 1
identity.why: with the cache off, the lifted check, the hashing of prefill blocks only, the recorded hits and the warm-up panel must not change a token

document.after: The content of the book is given below.

prefix.system_intro: You are a helpful assistant. Every conversation in this session shares the reference document below; it may be unrelated to the user's request.

dataset.name: nvidia/SPEED-Bench
dataset.throughput_8k: the revision of long_context in v2.4: fa4e669bee2a4393c56aa8ed05a7c667897f9590

prefix.rule:
tools/build_panel_prefix.py: the private parts picked as K128b's are, the first `measured` measured and the rest warm-up only; panel S

is a system turn of exactly P tokens in front of each private part, so its shared part fills P / 256 whole blocks; P = 0 is the private parts alone

main.jobs: one job per panel, in listed order; a job's report and its hits check before the next starts

definitions.G: Q_steady(line_pc) / Q_steady(line) - 1, the same seed and C
definitions.p: in the run with the cache off: the prefill steps' time inside the steady window over the window's time
definitions.h: 1 - t_pf(on) / t_pf(off); t_pf is the prefill steps' time inside the window over the requests those steps prefill
definitions.d: 1 - t_r(on) / t_r(off); t_r is the mean duration of the window's steps that decode or verify C rows
definitions.h_tok: over the requests prefilled inside the window of the run with the cache on: the sum of cached_tokens over the sum of prompt_len
definitions.rho_hat_0: (1 - p_k0 h_k0) / (1 - p h): the direction note's formula, the round unchanged
definitions.premise: rho_hat_0 and rho_hat_1 hold when a delivered token carries as many prefills and rounds with the cache on as off; the report lists tokens per round and the median output length of both

verdicts.hits: with the cache on every measured request of a run has cached_tokens >= the panel's shared_tokens, with it off every one has 0; and the run's prefill_tokens over its measured steps equal its requests' prompt_len - cached_tokens. Otherwise stop_if
verdicts.gain: per (panel, C, line): faster when every seed's 1 + G > 1 + 2 * N_t, slower when every seed's 1 + G < 1 - 2 * N_t, else undecided
verdicts.rho: per (panel, C, drafting line): decision.a_beats_b on the seeds' rho - 1
verdicts.formula: report only: per (panel, C, drafting line) the seeds' rho - rho_hat_0 and rho - rho_hat_1, median (min-max)
report_only: p, h, d, h_tok per line
TTFT p50 and p99 over every request and over the requests submitted inside the window, on and off
tokens per round and the median output length, on and off
the share of requests whose tokens are the same on and off

pilot.report: never: the pilot only sizes the main jobs

stop_if: identity finds a difference: no performance numbers from this tree; find the cause
an invalid run: its whole (panel, C, seed) rerun once, per invalid_if; still invalid: stop
